candidates: When lifting module-level variables into class fields during a refactor, use full descriptive names instead of abbreviations (e.g. `count` rather than `cnt`), and declare an explicit access modifier (`private`, `protected`, or `public`) on every field.

Changeset description messages must capitalize the first word of the description that follows the type prefix (e.g. write `chore: Update ...` or `feat: Add ...`, not `chore: update ...` or `feat: add ...`).
